entities.summary: Zhang Youxia is a Chinese general in the People's Liberation Army (PLA) and first-ranked vice chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC). Born in Beijing, Zhang is the son of General Zhang Zongxun. Joining the army in 1968, Zhang fought in the Sino-Vietnamese War of 1979, and the Battle of Laoshan in 1984, making him one of the few serving generals in China with war experience. In 2000, he became commander of the 13th Group Army. In 2005, he became the vice commander of the Beijing Military Region.
